test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A boatman rows 15 km in 15 minutes, along the stream and 10 km in 1 hour against the stream. Find the speed of the boat in still water.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Downstream speed (u) = (15 km ÷ 15) × 60 = 60 km/hr.

Upstream speed (v) = 10 km ÷ 1 = 10 km/hr.

**Speed of boat** in **still water** = (u + v) ÷ 2 = (60 + 10) ÷ 2 = 35 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Downstream Distance = 15 km, Downstream Time = 15 min = 15/60 hr = 1/4 hr.

Upstream Distance = 10 km, Upstream Time = 1 hr.

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed of boat (B) = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/227b76e3c5beff960c54fb9259b74b1cc8eefae96330289c2586feb72b45ff6f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream Speed (u) = 15 ÷ (1/4) = 15 × 4 = 60 km/hr

⇒ Upstream Speed (v) = 10 ÷ 1 = 10 km/hr

⇒ Speed of boat in **still water** = (60 + 10) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of boat = 70 ÷ 2 = 35 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 35 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Stream

The speed of the stream or current (w) is calculated as half the difference between downstream and upstream speeds: w = (u − v) ÷ 2.

Downstream vs Upstream

Downstream speed (u) = Boat speed (B) + Stream speed (w). Upstream speed (v) = Boat speed (B) − Stream speed (w).

Time Conversion

To convert minutes to hours, divide by 60. For example, 15 min = 15/60 = 0.25 hours.</p
